author: BigTonyFigz
quote: Dude.....Other than the combat and driving this game is a train wreck. It's been in development for 8 years and dips down to 15 fps a second. Extremely sanitized and "Modern" characters and story that feel like a shadow of former GTA games. I'm on Chapter 4 and don't wanna play anymore. I'm tired of it, i hate to use buzz words but it's "Woke Slop" I'm legit tired of games trying to be a corporate safe satisfaction game. That's all this is. Save your money and buy Mortal Shell 2 it's worth it ay all even for the online coming later.
